text:
maria: Heads-up — Pricing is splitting Pro SKU into Pro and Pro+ next month. Product expects some customers to migrate; pricing asked us for a capacity forecast and quota/rate-limit plan. Thoughts?

kevin: Do we have any estimates from PM? Need migration %, expected token uplift per customer, and expected peak window (hours/day). Also do we want to buy reserved or rely on burst?

maria: @kevin product sent a rough note: 20-40% of mid-market may move to Pro+. Avg token usage per user could jump ~2x during onboarding & evaluation. Peak windows likely morning PST + EU overlap.

maya: Ran a quick model. If 30% migrate and avg tokens x2 then:
- NA peak GPU-hr/day: +45%
- EU peak GPU-hr/day: +70% (we have less spare quota there)
Constraints: GCP nv48 quota in eu-west1 and slot shortages in us-central.

maya:
```
assumptions:
  users_migrate_pct: 0.30
  avg_token_mult: 2.0
estimates:
  na_peak_increase: 0.45
  eu_peak_increase: 0.70
```

tony: Mitigations:
- soft rate limits per account during rollout
- pre-warm pro-burst pool for top 50 accounts
- enable quantized fallback for heavy customers
- reduce default KV cache TTL to cut repeated prompts
Command to change pool:
`rwctl scale-pool --pool pro-burst --min 10 --max 50 --policy burst`

elaine: Cost readout from finance: rough monthly delta if we reserve capacity for 3 months:
- one-time reserved commit: +$120k
- variable usage addl: ~$45k/mo
Alternative: offer limited promo credits and stricter per-account quotas to defer reserve purchase.

kevin: If we throttle too hard we'll hurt PLG conversion. Proposal: canary by region (NA first), per-customer daily burst cap 50k tokens, 2-week opt-in period for Pro+ migration, monitor increase.

maria: Agreed. @maya can you produce a 72-hour peak-run plan and a procurement request for eu-west1 quota? Need approvals from infra + finance by EOD Fri. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sre-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-1234 — Pricing SKU split capacity forecast. Linked docs: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-1234

maya: I'll post the 72hr runbook by EOD and include a fallback to enable region-level read-only rate limits if we see >80% pool utilization.

kevin: Thanks all. Please flag any hard blockers. If eu-west quotas can't be raised quickly we need to consider region-routing customers to other regions with data residency opt-ins.
